test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

A child in an art museum is like __a bull in a China shop.__

options.text: A clumsy person in a delicate situation
A person who cries for everything
A person with no moral values

solution:
The correct answer is- '**A clumsy person in a delicate situation**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, ***option 1)*** gives the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.
 
• The idiom- '***a bull in a China shop'*** is used to refer to** a person who frequently makes mistakes or damages things when circumstances requires careful thinking or behavior.**
 
 
• **Example- **In his capacity as a politician, he was ***a bull in a china shop***__ and frequently had to apologize for his abrasive language.
 
 
 
• Thus,** option 1) **is the correct answer.
